concerns.text: FR-009 (Sim-to-Real Adapter/Fine-tuning Protocol) and Plan Phase 0.5 (Adapter Construction) lack a corresponding task. T020 only loads weights; no task exists to implement the training/fine-tuning logic (Linear Probe) or generate `data/processed/adapter_weights.pt`.

FR-006 and US-2 require logging failure modes to `data/interim/execution_logs.parquet`. T023 detects failure modes, but no task explicitly implements the persistence logic to write these labels to the parquet file referenced in T025.

FR-008 and Plan Phase 4 (Ablation Study) require orchestrating the comparative execution of 'Full Affordance' vs 'Simplified Connectivity' modes and generating `data/interim/ablation_results.parquet`. T039/T040 implement the modes, but no task exists to run the comparison or generate the output artifact.

Plan Phase 0 (Baseline Re-Execution) requires executing the original RoboDojo Neural Policy to generate `data/interim/baseline_results.parquet`. No task exists in tasks.md to load the 18 tasks and run this baseline execution.

FR-010 and US-4 require executing the control experiment (Oracle) and generating `data/interim/oracle_results.json`. T035 implements the Oracle, but no task exists to run the experiment sequence (feeding plans to Oracle) and generate the specific JSON artifact.

SC-005 requires measuring catastrophic failure rate against a ≤ 5% threshold. T032 calculates the rate, but no task explicitly defines the threshold constant, performs the comparison check, and flags the pass/fail result in the final report.

US-1 Acceptance Scenario 3 requires the process to NOT crash due to OOM if RAM > 6GB. T017 monitors memory, but no task explicitly implements the enforcement logic (e.g., raising an error or halting execution) when the 6GB limit is exceeded.
